top_signals.title: Maniatis: Oman Spill Cleanup May Cost USD 200-500M
top_signals.summary: Specialists are racing to salvage a sinking shadow-fleet tanker off Oman that has caused a massive oil slick. Personnel have already boarded the Caroline Bezengi, a Suezmax that has grounded off Oman’s southern coast. Dimitris Maniatis, CEO of maritime risk management firm Marisks spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the short & long-term consequences of such a spill. (Source: Bloomberg)
